description: This file implements a handler class for transforming /chat/completions API requests into litellm.responses requests and processes responses, including conversion between internal representations and external API formats, stream iteration, and response handling logic.

classes.name: LiteLLMResponsesTransformationHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for transforming chat completion API requests/responses to and from the litellm.responses format, including request transformation, response parsing, and streaming iteration.

classes.name: OpenAiResponsesToChatCompletionStreamIterator
classes.description: A stream iterator class that converts streaming responses from the Responses API into OpenAI chat completion stream format, handling various event types and chunks.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[Any],int] _handle_raw_dict_response_item( self, item: Dict[str, Any], index: int )
methods.description: Handles raw dictionary response items, converting message, reasoning, or function call items into internal choice representations.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Any],Optional[str]] convert_chat_completion_messages_to_responses_api( self, messages: List["AllMessageValues"] )
methods.description: Converts a list of chat messages into the Responses API input format, including handling system, user, tool, and assistant messages.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List["AllMessageValues"], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, litellm_logging_obj: "LiteLLMLoggingObj", client: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Builds the Responses API request payload from input parameters and chat messages, including optional parameters and session management.

methods.description: Transforms Responses API output items into chat completion choice objects, handling message content, reasoning summaries, and tool calls.

methods.name: "ModelResponse" transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: "BaseModel", model_response: "ModelResponse", logging_obj: "LiteLLMLoggingObj", request_data: dict, messages: List["AllMessageValues"], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
